review.use_summary: Fitted a normal distribution to co-accessibility scores from shuffled cCRE matrices for subclass-specific background comparisons.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph names fitdistrplus but does not give its function, estimation method or package version. BH FDR<0.001 follows the normal-background fit. Its wording says scores significantly larger than background were filtered out; preserve that wording and do not infer a reversed retention rule, shuffle implementation, normality or independence. Native analytical normal-mle is an explicit supported subset, not a reconstruction of the unknown paper method or the original numerical optimizer.
